entities.summary: Thomas Keith FRCSEd was a Victorian surgeon and amateur photographer from Scotland. He developed and improved the wax paper process and his photographs are recognised for their composition and use of shade. He was an early practitioner of the operation of ovariotomy where his published results were amongst the best in the world.
